xkbmodel.description: Specifies the XKB keyboard model name. Default: pc105 on most platforms.

xkblayout.description: Specifies the XKB keyboard layout name. This is usually the country or language type of the keyboard. Default: us on most platforms

xkbvariant.description: Specifies the XKB keyboard variant components. Default: not set (empty string).

xkboptions.description: Specifies the XKB keyboard option components. Options usually relate to the behavior of the special keys. Default: not set (empty string).

backspace.description: Determines the behavior of <BackSpace> and <Delete> keys on the console. Allowed values: bs, del and guess.

kmap.description: Usually this variable will be unset but if you don't want to use a XKB layout on the console, you can specify an alternative keymap here.
